responseText:
I can’t run in the background or send you a message later on my own. I’m uncertain about exactly what you want me to do during those hours and which platform you want to be notified on.

Options I can do right now in this chat (pick one):
1) Do the work now and deliver the result in this chat within a few hours. Tell me the task, deadline, output format, and any constraints, and I’ll start immediately. I’ll post the finished result here when done.  
2) Prepare the content/results now and also produce a message/email/slack text you can schedule to be sent later (I’ll give the exact draft and simple scheduling steps).  
3) Give step‑by‑step instructions for scheduling an automated notification on a platform you use (Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Slack, iPhone/Android reminders, Zapier/IFTTT, Twilio/SMS). I can include copy-ready templates.

Quick scheduling instructions (pick platform if you want a full walkthrough):
- Gmail: Compose → click arrow next to Send → Schedule send → pick time. I can provide the full email body.
- Outlook (web/desktop): Compose → Send options → Schedule send/Delay Delivery → choose time.
- Google Calendar: Create event → Add notification → choose Email or Popup → set time before event. Or create event at finish time and add yourself as attendee (you’ll get email).
- Slack: Open DM → type message → click arrow next to Send → Schedule message → pick time. Or use /remind me "…" at a specific time.
- iPhone Reminders/Shortcuts: Add reminder or create a Shortcut that sends a message at time.
- Android: Use Google Calendar reminder, or Assistant routines, or third‑party apps.
- Zapier/IFTTT: Create a zap/recipe that triggers at a scheduled time and sends email/SMS/Slack/etc. (I can give exact steps for Zapier/IFTTT and sample payloads.)

What I need from you to proceed right away:
- Describe the task you want done (details, scope, deliverable format).  
- Desired finish time or deadline (date/time, timezone).  
- How would you like to be notified (email, Slack, SMS, calendar reminder, etc.) and any account/recipient details (or say you’ll schedule the message yourself and I’ll provide the draft).  

I can start immediately after you reply. I’m uncertain about which option you prefer and what the task is—please tell me which of the above you want.
